He obtained his boards in Pathology in 1952 and since that time has been active in teaching, research and practice at the Albany Medical College-Albany Medical Center Hospital. Also, during this time he has had considerable experience in the comparative pathology aspects of toxicology and environmental medicine and computer applications for research and administration in these areas.
